request.brief: Divided Army Loyalties, a Qing penalty during the 1911 Xinhai Revolution reducing army attack, defense and organization. One large, centered 1911 Qing New Army peaked field cap, slate-blue wool with worn brass edging, torn across its front into two opposed halves. The cracked cap is a single coherent silhouette that conveys a divided command. Painterly aged steel and subdued early twentieth-century military cloth; readable at 60×68. Complete opaque subject with transparency only outside the silhouette. No frame or box, no portrait, no text, no numeral, no banner, no communist insignia, no modern equipment. Use the reference for vanilla national-spirit rendering and size only, never copy its subject.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV idea and national spirit picture: Divided Army Loyalties, a Qing penalty during the 1911 Xinhai Revolution reducing army attack, defense and organization. One large, centered 1911 Qing New Army peaked field cap, slate-blue wool with worn brass edging, torn across its front into two opposed halves. The cracked cap is a single coherent silhouette that conveys a divided command. Painterly aged steel and subdued early twentieth-century military cloth; readable at 60×68. Complete opaque subject with transparency only outside the silhouette. No frame or box, no portrait, no text, no numeral, no banner, no communist insignia, no modern equipment. Use the reference for vanilla national-spirit rendering and size only, never copy its subject.

Requirements:
- One centred subject, an emblem, a figure, an object or a small scene, readable at 60x68 pixels: a few large, clear shapes with readable contrast and no fine detail that disappears at that size.
- Painterly, slightly aged texture in the style of Hearts of Iron IV interface art.
- Real transparent background: no backdrop, no frame, no border, no plate behind the subject.
- Leave a small empty margin around the subject.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a frame or border.

Produce exactly one image.
